title: ArcCivs 0.1.207 to0.1.208 Auto commerce buffer, lab
assumptions: Activity assumptions, not measured: low/base/high 2/8/24 trades per active hour, 0.5/1/2 hours per player-day.
Every trade transfers exactly one existing emerald between player and one native settlement treasury; no issued currency, initial funding, top-up or virtual purse.
All 26 sell-to-city bundles are priced one emerald; city-to-player quantity is exactly half. Rate map below. Existing outstanding demands and native reserves cap offers.
No currency conversion to Vault/tokens, no XP reward. Same-material round trip loses half of the goods. Logs/planks ratio4, wheat/bread ratio3, ore/furnace ratio1 retained in bundle ratios.
City gross per-day emerald outflow is bounded by physical treasury, which only purchases by players or actual manual physical deposits replenish; multi-account does not bypass this.
Initial treasury is unchanged; zero emerald grants. Pre-existing normal Auto native-material grants remain separate and unchanged; ordinary settlements do not receive them.

Native0.1.207 observations: two non-owner BUY trades succeeded, physical emeralds transferred player→market; neither funded Auto market offered SELL after native stock refresh. This is one QA journey, not income telemetry.

Before: Auto shortfall against operational reserve D is immediately refilled by the existing Auto privilege. After: commerce alone protects R=D+one existing bid bundle for materials with proven D>0. Shared snapshots, ordinary settlements and Auto grants retain D unchanged.

No buffer during an unknown paid construction bill: fallback observed.stock protects existing contents and is not proved demand. Buffer is one per material per city, never per store, builder or account.
For cobblestone D16 and S16, bid64 gives R80 and one SELL64. S80 closes both sides; S79 after real consumption does not reopen SELL64; BUY32 starts only at S112. Same R guards both directions.

At fixed D, at most one additional bid bundle per material relative to prior reserve; at most26 eligible types, initial payout bounded by min(actual treasury E, eligible types). New payouts need real consumption of a complete bid; changing accounts does not multiply the target.

All26 rates, one-emerald quotes and two-to-one bid/ask quantity spread remain unchanged. Native goods only transfer. Existing Auto item grants remain a separate old flow; commerce buffer does not request a new grant.

Gross transfer scenarios remain low/base/high1/8/48 per player-day; these are assumptions with finite native stock/treasury constraints, not measured new income. Vault/tokens/XP mint/burn and disposable income stay0.

Same-material or listed crafting round trips retain their prior loss. External villager/ESG exchange profitability is not established and remains an observation gap; production is outside activation scope.

flows.basis: Gross transfer assumption both before and after; buffer changes finite offer availability, not mint or unit prices.
